summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Zhitian Zhang effective May 15, 2026 for personal reasons, with no disagreements with the company. The board will search for internal and external candidates. In the interim, CEO Hua Chen will assume principal financial officer duties alongside the financial controller. This is a non-routine departure caused by abrupt resignation, not a routine meeting notice. Advisory firms or break fees are not mentioned. Watch for the appointment of a permanent CFO and any potential accounting or operational implications.
